<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Sentiment:</strong> Indian indices are trading higher, supported by a rally in IT stocks and softer US inflation data, despite ongoing concerns over rising crude oil prices and West Asia geopolitical tensions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Bond Yields and Currency:</strong> Indian 10-year bond yields eased to 6.75% following US inflation data, even as the rupee faced slight pressure, slipping to 96.31 against the US dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a></span></li>
